sealed.statement: Query routing served through the single readiness planning owner keeps the sealed cache-lag contract: a lagged or regressed visible node row does not refute a completed or stored readiness snapshot whose lease, services version, transport, and invalidation witnesses still hold, so a replica stays routable until its ready lease expires and stops exactly then; a barrier-blocked read without reusable stored evidence still fails closed and never builds through the barrier; the one-time bootstrap build admits a current completed record even when its own reads adopt an observed source change, by re-capturing at most once and never stamping an answer under an identity it did not build from; and every Quest 2 planning-currency witness stays green.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

A bridged completed snapshot is served unchanged and is never republished or re-stamped under the unclassified or rotated planning identity; the queued build remains the only path to a new completed record.

A barrier-blocked read whose stored evidence fails any CL-012 reuse witness (watermark, services version, transport, independent invalidation, lease) is served the deferred fail-closed snapshot; the bridge never widens what the stored-snapshot reuse owner admits.
The initial bootstrap re-captures at most once and only when the build's own reads adopted a source change; it never builds through an unclassified change or invalid transport topology.
